source.note: A commit with dirty files is a working-tree build, not a deployed release. Per-navigation HTML hashes identify the tested preview output.

method.engine: Playwright Chromium, reduced-motion mobile viewport; browser default zoom retained
method.text: Computed fonts for rendered authored text nodes, inputs and generated before/after content; hidden/inert/screen-reader-only trees excluded.
method.touch: Measured main upload controls, mobile navigation/language options, editorial guide links and visible result controls. Ordinary inline prose links are not primary touch targets.
method.tables: Page overflow, table bounds outside the viewport and inner horizontal table overflow fail. CSS overflow mode is also recorded so a contained scroll area can be distinguished from page overflow.
method.results: Six real uploaded states in all four languages at 320px; English states also at375/390/430px. PNG cleanup requires an explicit recorded button click.
method.fixtures: Synthetic teaching files only. MP4 is container-only/non-playable; WAV has a known quick-parser warning; C2PA uses an unsigned JPEG.
method.requests: Analytics/RUM event endpoints and all non-GET/HEAD requests intercepted; this layout test is not analytics execution or privacy certification.
method.evidence: New output JSON and failure screenshots are preserved; existing output filenames are never overwritten.
